We join Bobby Falkenberg as he joins Bret Ferguson from Double T Outfitters. Bobby is an avid outdoorsman, judge, and father. Bret manages 30,000 acres in Ozona TX, the knowledge he has of every inch of this amazing low fence ranch is remarkable.
The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters becomes a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin; in 2021, Gavin is able to take his largest buck to date with his dad, Heath, behind the camera.
